project.name: E-Commerce Microservices Platform
project.description: Aggregator POM for the E-Commerce microservices reactor. This module is NOT a Maven parent for the services below -- each service pom.xml declares spring-boot-starter-parent directly and is fully self-contained, so it can be built with a Docker build context scoped to just that service's own directory (backend/<service>). This module exists purely so `mvn -f backend/pom.xml clean install` can build/test all services in one pass (e.g. in CI) without needing a Docker context that spans the whole backend/ tree.
